faq.sousTitre: Everything you need to know to report, search and find a pet with animALERTE.

items.q: Is it free to post a listing?
items.r: Reporting a found pet is always free. For a lost pet, a free plan lets you post on animalerte.ca, and paid plans widen the reach of your alert.

items.q: How long does my listing stay online?
items.r: A listing stays online for 365 days while the pet is still being sought.

items.q: Do I need an account to post?
items.r: Yes. A free account lets you post, edit and manage your listings in one place.

items.q: What is the difference between the plans?
items.r: The plan sets the reach of your alert, from your immediate neighbourhood to all of Quebec. The wider the reach, the more people search with you.
flAIr is our artificial intelligence system that recognizes a pet's face, meaning its coat, its markings and its eye colour, then alerts you the moment a found pet looks like yours.
A Sentinel is a person or business, such as a vet, a pet store or a citizen, who receives alerts for their area and helps reunite families with their pet.

items.q: I found my pet, what should I do?
items.r: Go to “My listings” and mark the listing as resolved. Your story encourages the whole community.
animALERTE focuses on Quebec, while remaining available in both French and English.

items.q: How do I edit or remove my listing?
items.r: From “My listings”, you can reopen, mark as resolved or delete a listing at any time.

marketing.flairTitre: flAIr sniffs out the matches for you.
marketing.flairTexte: flAIr is an artificial intelligence system that recognizes an animal's face: its coat, its markings and its eye colour. It watches your area around the clock and, the moment a found pet looks like yours, flAIr lets you know.
marketing.flairIntro: flAIr is the artificial intelligence system built by animALERTE to reconnect lost and found pets. It watches new reports in your area around the clock and analyzes every listing against several criteria. Rather than flooding you with random suggestions, it surfaces only credible leads: before alerting you, flAIr weighs each match to keep only the ones that are genuinely plausible.
marketing.crit1Texte: flAIr compares the shape of the ears, eyes and nose, along with the colour and pattern of the coat on the face.
marketing.crit2Texte: The type and length of the fur, shorthair or longhair, refine the match.
marketing.crit3Texte: Two nearby towns raise the likelihood of a real match; nearby matches are prioritized.
marketing.crit4Texte: flAIr checks the timeline: an animal found on or after the disappearance date stays plausible; found before it, the match is impossible and is discarded.

conditions.sousTitre: The rules that govern the use of animALERTE.

sections.texte: By creating an account or using animALERTE, you agree to these terms of use. If you do not agree with any of them, please do not use the service.

animALERTE is a community broadcast tool that helps report and find lost or found pets in Quebec. The service connects owners, the community, and a network of businesses and partners called "Sentinels".

animALERTE in no way guarantees that a reported animal will be found. The service is a visibility and broadcast tool; it does not replace your own efforts or the services of a professional. We provide you with means, without any obligation of result.

Posting a listing requires an account. You are responsible for the accuracy of your information and the confidentiality of your password. You must be of legal age or have the authorization of a parent or guardian.

You warrant that the information and photos you post are accurate, belong to you or that you have the right to use them, and do not infringe the rights of others. We may remove any listing that is misleading, fraudulent, offensive, or non-compliant.

Reporting a found animal is always free. For a lost animal, paid plans (a one-time payment per listing, no subscription) unlock additional broadcast features. Payments are securely processed by our payment provider; animALERTE never stores your card details. All payments are final: no refunds are possible, including where a listing did not lead to the animal being found. While your listing is active, you may at any time move from a free plan to a paid plan by paying that plan’s full price. Upgrading from a paid plan to a higher one (paying only the difference) is, however, only possible within twenty-four (24) hours of paying for the current plan; after that period, the paid plan becomes final. No plan downgrade or refund is possible.

The Regional and Province-wide plans grant priority display: your listing appears at the top of the lists and in the priority alerts carousel on the home page for seven (7) days following payment. After that period, your listing remains active and viewable for up to one year, but is no longer given priority placement. An upgrade to a higher plan, made within the permitted window, restarts this seven (7) day period from the moment of the upgrade.

Depending on the plan, an "alert" includes a broadcast on our geolocated internal network (Sentinel) and targeted advertising on Meta platforms (Facebook and Instagram) within a given radius. The reach of alerts varies by plan and does not constitute a guarantee of exposure to a specific audience.

animALERTE protects your personal contact details: they never appear publicly on a listing or poster. People who find your animal can reach you through the toll-free line or anonymous messaging, without your personal number being disclosed.

To the extent permitted by law, animALERTE and Sauvetage Animal Rescue cannot be held liable for direct or indirect damages related to the use of the service, the accuracy of listings, the behaviour of users, or the outcome of a report.
The processing of your personal information is described in our privacy policy. By using the service, you consent to this processing.
We may change these terms at any time. The update date above indicates the version in effect. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
For any questions about these terms, please use the Contact page.

confidentialite.sousTitre: How animALERTE collects, uses and protects your information.

sections.texte: animALERTE (Sauvetage Animal Rescue) is responsible for the personal information collected by the service. We process it in accordance with the laws applicable in Quebec, including Law 25 on the protection of personal information.

Account: email, name, password (encrypted). Listings: information about the animal, photos, location and dates, and your contact details. Location: city and postal code, to target alerts in your area. Payment: handled by our provider (Stripe); we never store your card details. Technical data: essential cookies and connection logs.
We use your information to publish your listings, power flAIr matching, send relevant alerts, process payments, and communicate with you about the service.

Your personal contact details never appear publicly on a listing or poster. People who find your animal reach you through the toll-free line or anonymous messaging, without your personal number being disclosed.

We share the minimum necessary: with the Sentinel network (geolocated alerts), with Meta platforms for targeted advertising (their own policies apply), and with our payment provider. We never sell your personal information.
We keep your information as long as necessary for the purposes described. A listing remains viewable for up to one year; account information is kept until the account is deleted.
You may access your information, have it corrected, withdraw your consent, or request deletion of your account. To exercise these rights, use the Contact page.
We use cookies essential to the operation of the site, notably to keep you signed in. We limit cookies to the strict minimum.
We take reasonable measures to protect your information. As no system is infallible, we cannot guarantee absolute security.
We may change this policy at any time. The update date above indicates the version in effect.
For any questions about this policy or your information, please use the Contact page.

pageFiche.accroche: The central point of every search. Everything starts here, and everything leads back here.
pageFiche.centralTexte: The listing is where all the information comes together. Every QR code leads to the listing. Every social media post leads to the listing. And it is from the listing that people can reach the pet's family, in full confidentiality.
pageFiche.quoiTexte: A public listing for your lost or found pet. It shows the photo, the details such as species, breed, colour and distinctive marks, along with the location and date. It appears in the directory, in search and on the map, viewable by the whole community.
pageFiche.problemeTexte: A social media post disappears into the feed within hours. The listing, on the other hand, gives your pet a permanent, searchable page. The person who finds it can look it up by area, species or colour, even several days later.
pageFiche.etape1Texte: Everything starts with your profile. You fill in your contact details once, and they are reused for all your listings, with nothing to retype.
pageFiche.etape2Texte: Photo, details, location and date. A few minutes is all it takes.
pageFiche.etape3Texte: The listing appears right away in search and on the map, with its own unique file number.
pageFiche.etape4Texte: QR codes and social posts lead back to it. The person who finds the pet reaches the family without ever seeing their contact details.
apports: Permanent visibility, never buried in a news feed.
Filtered search by species, area and colour.
The location on your area's map.
Your contact details kept confidential.
A listing you can edit at any time.
Free to get started.
pageFiche.forfaitTexte: The listing is included in every plan, even the Free one. It is the foundation. Paid plans add broadcasting and alerts on top.
pageFiche.ctaTexte: The first step is your profile.

pagePhotos.accroche: A good, face-on photo gives flAIr and the community their best chance of recognizing your pet.
pagePhotos.centralTexte: The very first photo should show the pet's face, as front-facing as possible. That is what flAIr analyzes for recognition, and it is the first thing the community looks at. If you only have one photo, choose the one of the face.
pagePhotos.quoiTexte: Depending on your plan, you add 1 to 4 photos to your listing. The first one is the star: it appears everywhere, on the listing, on the poster and on social media. The others show the pet from other angles.
pagePhotos.pourquoiTexte: flAIr compares the face, the ears, the muzzle, the eyes and the coat pattern. The more front-facing, sharp and well-lit the photo is, the more reliable recognition becomes. A blurry or distant photo lowers your chances.
pagePhotos.commentTitre: How to take a good photo
pagePhotos.etape1Texte: Get down to the pet's level, right in front of it.
pagePhotos.etape2Texte: Daylight is ideal. The details and true colours should be visible.
pagePhotos.etape3Texte: The face fills a good part of the frame, without being cut off.
pagePhotos.etape4Texte: No glare and no shadow across the face.
pagePhotos.etape5Texte: The pet should look like it does today.
pagePhotos.supplementairesTexte: With plans that offer more than one photo, use them for wider views: the full body, a side profile, or a distinctive mark such as a patch, a scar or a collar.
eviter: Photos taken from too far away.
Group photos where you can't tell which one it is.
pagePhotos.forfaitTexte: 1 photo on Free, 2 on Local alert, 3 on Regional alert, 4 on Province-wide alert.
pagePhotos.ctaTexte: The first step is your profile.

pageCourriel.accroche: The moment you report your pet, you receive an email that gathers everything you need to know and do in the first few hours.
pageCourriel.centralTexte: When a pet goes missing, every hour counts, and it is not always clear where to start. This email gives you, right away, the actions that truly raise your chances, prepared with specialists in lost-pet search.
pageCourriel.quoiTexte: An email sent automatically when you create your listing. It gathers a bank of advice built with animal behaviourists and people who specialize in finding lost pets.
pageCourriel.pourquoiTexte: In a panic, we often react the wrong way. Chasing a frightened animal or shouting its name can push it further away. The email brings back the right reflexes, the ones that actually work.
contient: The first steps to take within the first minutes.
Where and how to search. A cat often hides very close by, a dog can travel far.
How to approach a frightened animal without scaring it off.
Who to contact: shelters, vets, animal services and groups in your area.
How to spread your listing effectively around you.
The most common mistakes, and how to avoid them.
pageCourriel.statsTexte: Our advice draws on data from thousands of searches. We know what brings pets home, and we share it with you plainly.
pageCourriel.forfaitTexte: The advice email is included in every plan, even the Free one.
pageCourriel.ctaTexte: The first step is your profile.

pageAffiche.surtitre: Ready to print, in one click
pageAffiche.accroche: A professional poster, generated automatically from your listing, ready to put up around your area.
pageAffiche.centralTitre: The QR code leads back to the listing
pageAffiche.centralTexte: The poster shows the essentials at a glance. Its large QR code leads straight to the online listing, which is more complete, the heart of the animALERTE system. Anyone who sees the poster can scan it and land on your up-to-date listing.
pageAffiche.quoiTexte: A PDF poster, created automatically by the system. It reuses the photo and information from your listing: the name, the description, the area and the date, with a large QR code.
pageAffiche.etape1Texte: The information from the form and your photo feed the poster. There is no layout to do.
pageAffiche.etape2Texte: No software, no design work. The poster is ready in seconds.
pageAffiche.etape3Titre: You download it as a PDF
pageAffiche.etape3Texte: Print it at home, or save it to a USB key to bring to a print centre or a big-box store.
pageAffiche.etape4Titre: You put it up in your area
pageAffiche.etape4Texte: On poles, at local shops, in parks. Anyone who sees it can scan the QR code.
pageAffiche.pourquoiTexte: A poster has little space. The online listing, on the other hand, holds everything: more photos, more details, the area map, and the way to reach the pet's family without ever revealing their contact details. The QR code bridges the poster and the listing.
apports: A professional look, with no layout effort.
The photo and information already filled in.
A large QR code to your up-to-date listing.
A PDF ready to print anywhere.
A poster you can regenerate if your information changes.
pageAffiche.forfaitTexte: The smart poster is included starting with the Local alert plan.
pageAffiche.ctaTexte: The first step is your profile.

pageReseaux.surtitre: Ready to post, ready to share
pageReseaux.accroche: Ready-to-post images and ready-to-paste text, generated automatically for your social media.
pageReseaux.centralTexte: The system creates optimized images and a ready-written post for you, in animALERTE's colours. All you do is download and copy-paste. Just like on the poster, a QR code brings everyone back to your online listing.
pageReseaux.quoiTexte: From your listing, animALERTE automatically generates two images, a square one for Facebook and Instagram posts, and a vertical one for stories, along with a ready-written post.
pageReseaux.etape1Texte: Your photo and the listing details feed the images and the text.
pageReseaux.etape2Texte: The square and story images, as well as the post, are ready in seconds.
pageReseaux.etape3Texte: One button downloads the images, another copies the post in a single click.
pageReseaux.etape4Texte: On Facebook, Instagram and your other networks. Every share widens the search.
pageReseaux.publicationTexte: The text is written in an effective missing-pet tone, with the right information and a link to your listing. Nothing to write, just copy and paste.
apports: A square image and a story image, ready to post.
A ready-written post, to copy and paste.
A QR code and a link that lead back to your listing.
No design or writing to do.
All in animALERTE's colours.
pageReseaux.forfaitTexte: Social media images and post are included starting with the Regional alert plan.
pageReseaux.ctaTexte: The first step is your profile.

pageLigne.accroche: A single number that lets people reach you without ever revealing your personal number.
pageLigne.centralTexte: The person who finds your pet calls an animALERTE line, never your cell phone. The call is forwarded to you, and your contact details are never revealed. You stay reachable, but anonymous.
pageLigne.quoiTexte: A toll-free number, 1 833 999 AIDE (1 833 999 2433), shown on your listing, your poster and your posts. It is the number the person who finds your pet dials.
pageLigne.etape1Texte: They see the number on the poster, the listing or a post.
pageLigne.etape3Texte: The system asks for the 4-digit file number, shown on your poster and your listing.
pageLigne.etape4Titre: The call is forwarded to you
pageLigne.etape4Texte: Straight to the pet's family, without ever revealing their personal number.
pageLigne.pourquoiTexte: Posting your cell number everywhere exposes you to unwanted calls, scammers and a loss of privacy. The 1 833 999 AIDE line protects you: you stay reachable, but your number stays confidential.
pageLigne.exclusiviteTexte: animALERTE is the only lost-pet service to offer a direct, confidential line to the family. It is how we combine effectiveness and safety.
apports: You stay reachable at all times.
Your personal number is never revealed.
Protection against unwanted calls and fraud.
A single, easy-to-remember number.
Works with the poster, the listing and posts.
pageLigne.forfaitTexte: The toll-free line 1 833 999 AIDE is included starting with the Local alert plan.
pageLigne.ctaTexte: The first step is your profile.

pageMessagerie.surtitre: Write, without sharing your contact details
pageMessagerie.accroche: Another way to reach you in full confidentiality, right from your listing.
pageMessagerie.centralTitre: A message, without sharing a number
pageMessagerie.centralTexte: The person who saw your pet writes to you from the listing. You receive their message, you can reply, and neither side sees the other's contact details. Everything goes through animALERTE.
pageMessagerie.quoiTexte: A button on your listing lets anyone with information write to you directly. The exchange goes through animALERTE: neither you nor the other person has to reveal a phone number or email.
pageMessagerie.etape1Texte: The button is right on your listing.
pageMessagerie.etape2Texte: For example: "I think I saw your cat on Elm Street."
pageMessagerie.etape3Texte: You get an email notification, and the message shows up in your account.
pageMessagerie.etape4Texte: You continue the conversation if you wish, still without revealing your contact details.
pageMessagerie.pourquoiTexte: Some people prefer to write rather than call, especially for a simple tip or to attach a photo. Messaging complements the toll-free line: two ways to reach you, always keeping your contact details confidential.
apports: Write instead of calling, when it is simpler.
Contact details are never revealed, on either side.
Your messages centralized in your account.
An email notification for every message.
Ideal for sharing a tip or a photo.
pageMessagerie.forfaitTexte: Anonymous messaging is included starting with the Local alert plan.
pageMessagerie.ctaTexte: The first step is your profile.

pageSentinelle.surtitre: One of the two halves of the alert
pageSentinelle.accroche: Your listing is broadcast to a network of people and businesses in your area, ready to keep an eye out.
pageSentinelle.centralTitre: Eyes right where your pet went missing
pageSentinelle.centralTexte: As soon as you launch the alert, animALERTE notifies its geolocated internal network around the place of disappearance: Sentinel residents, vets, pet shops and animal services.
pageSentinelle.quoiTexte: The Sentinel broadcast is one of the two halves of an animALERTE alert. It is a notification sent to our internal database, filtered by where your pet was last seen.
pageSentinelle.etape1Texte: By choosing a paid plan, you activate the broadcast.
pageSentinelle.etape2Texte: The system finds the Sentinels and businesses within the radius around the disappearance.
pageSentinelle.etape3Texte: Each one receives a notification with your pet and your area.
pageSentinelle.etape4Texte: The more people watching in the right place, the faster your pet can be spotted.
pageSentinelle.reseauTexte: The Sentinel network brings together registered residents, vets, pet shops and animal services. They are the people most likely to come across your pet. You too can be part of it by becoming a Sentinel.
pageSentinelle.rayonTitre: A radius based on your plan
pageSentinelle.rayonTexte: The reach depends on your plan: 5 km on the Local alert, 25 km on the Regional alert, and all of Quebec on the Province-wide alert.
apports: A broadcast targeted to the right area.
A network of people and businesses on the lookout.
More eyes in the right place, more chances.
A radius suited to your plan.
The other half of the alert, targeted Meta ads.
pageSentinelle.forfaitTexte: The Sentinel broadcast is included starting with the Local alert, with a radius that grows with the plan.
pageSentinelle.ctaTexte: The first step is your profile.

pagePubMeta.surtitre: The other half of the alert
pagePubMeta.accroche: Your pet's post is shared on the animALERTE Facebook page, then boosted in your area to reach far more people.
pagePubMeta.centralTitre: Meta's broadcast power, working for you
pagePubMeta.centralTexte: Meta puts its broadcast reach at our disposal. We use it to push your pet's post to the right people, in the right place.
pagePubMeta.quoiTexte: Your pet appears on the animALERTE Facebook page, then that post is boosted, a paid ad on Meta, to greatly increase its reach in a specific area.
pagePubMeta.etape1Texte: From your photos and details, a post is prepared for Facebook and Instagram.
pagePubMeta.etape2Titre: It is published on the animALERTE page
pagePubMeta.etape2Texte: Your pet appears naturally on our Facebook page.
pagePubMeta.etape3Texte: We turn the post into a targeted Meta ad, shown to people in your area.
pagePubMeta.etape4Texte: The reach goes far beyond a simple share, right where your pet went missing.
pagePubMeta.boostTexte: Boosting a post means paying Meta to show it to many more people than a simple share. We choose the geographic area, and Meta places it in the news feed of the people who are there.
pagePubMeta.rayonTexte: The area targeted depends on your plan: a 5 km radius on the Local alert, 25 km on the Regional alert, and all of Quebec on the Province-wide alert.
pagePubMeta.porteeTitre: The higher you go, the more people you reach
pagePubMeta.porteeTexte: Targeted advertising is included from the Local alert. Moving up the plans widens the area and greatly increases the number of people reached.
apports: Your pet on the animALERTE Facebook page.
A boosted post, not just a share.
Precise targeting, right where your pet went missing.
Reach that grows with your plan.
The other half of the alert, the Sentinel broadcast.
pagePubMeta.forfaitTexte: Targeted Meta advertising is included from the Local alert, with an area that grows with the plan.
pagePubMeta.ctaTexte: The first step is your profile.

pagePrioritaire.accroche: Your listing is featured for seven days: at the top of the reports and in the very first section of the home page.
pagePrioritaire.centralTitre: Front and centre, where people look first
pagePrioritaire.centralTexte: As soon as you pay, your listing is placed ahead of the others, in the most-seen spots on the site, so the most people notice it quickly.
pagePrioritaire.quoiTexte: The priority listing features your report in two key places: the “Priority alerts” carousel, the first section of the home page, and the top of the report lists.
pagePrioritaire.etape1Titre: You choose the Regional or Province-wide alert
pagePrioritaire.etape1Texte: Priority display activates as soon as you pay.
pagePrioritaire.etape2Titre: Your listing moves to the front
pagePrioritaire.etape2Texte: It appears at the top of the report lists, ahead of ordinary listings.
pagePrioritaire.etape3Texte: It takes its place in the “Priority alerts” carousel, the first section of the site.
pagePrioritaire.etape4Texte: Your listing stays featured for the seven days following payment.
pagePrioritaire.dureeTexte: Priority display lasts seven days after payment. After that, your listing stays active and viewable for up to a year, but is no longer featured as a priority.
apports: A spot at the top of the reports.

pagePrioritaire.forfaitTexte: The priority listing is included from the Regional alert.

pagePartenaire.accroche: Your listing is also posted on the Sauvetage Animal Rescue Facebook page, followed by more than 100,000 animal lovers across Quebec.
pagePartenaire.centralTitre: An engaged community of more than 100,000 people
pagePartenaire.centralTexte: Sauvetage Animal Rescue is our partner. Its Facebook page is followed by more than 100,000 people, mostly Quebecers passionate about animals and mindful of their well-being.
pagePartenaire.quoiTexte: Partner broadcast means posting your pet on both the animALERTE Facebook page and the Sauvetage Animal Rescue page, doubling the reach among a community already gathered around the animal cause.
pagePartenaire.etape1Texte: Partner broadcast is exclusive to this plan.
pagePartenaire.etape2Titre: Your pet is posted on animALERTE
pagePartenaire.etape2Texte: The post appears on our Facebook page.
pagePartenaire.etape3Titre: And on the Sauvetage Animal Rescue page
pagePartenaire.etape3Texte: The same post is shared on our partner’s Facebook page.
pagePartenaire.etape4Texte: More than 100,000 Quebec animal lovers can see it and share it.
pagePartenaire.communauteTitre: A community that cares about the cause
pagePartenaire.communauteTexte: These are not random followers: the Sauvetage Animal Rescue community is engaged, mindful of animal welfare and firmly rooted in Quebec. When a pet goes missing, these people share, comment and keep an eye out.

pistesFlair.sousTitre: flAIr compares this pet with reports from the other side (lost and found) and surfaces the most plausible leads. It is up to you to verify.
pistesFlair.aucune: No plausible lead yet. flAIr keeps watching new reports in your area.
pistesFlair.verrou: flAIr can automatically look for matches among found pets and alert you. Included from the Regional alert.

photos.intro: Add general views of your pet (full body, markings, from behind…). The main photo (the face) is managed from the form.
photos.complet: You have reached the photo limit of your plan.
photos.erreurLimite: Photo limit reached for this plan.

messages.contacterIntro: Did you see this pet or do you have information? Write to the family. Your email stays private and is never shown to them.
messages.placeholderContact: e.g., I think I saw this pet near…
messages.erreurChamps: Please enter a valid email and a message.
messages.erreurSoi: You cannot message your own listing.
messages.confidentialite: animALERTE relays messages without ever sharing either person’s email.
messages.envoyeTexte: The family has been notified. You will receive an email with a private link to follow the conversation, without creating an account.
messages.boiteVide: You have no messages yet. When someone writes to you about one of your pets, the conversation will appear here.
messages.lienPrive: This is your private link for this conversation. Do not share it.
